newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-LAST QUOTES - Australian Eurobond benchmarks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-LAST QUOTES - Australian Eurobond benchmarks.

text.p: Last quotes from the International Securities Market Association for benchmark Australian dollar Eurobonds issued by Australian entities.
A busy night for Australian dollar Eurobonds, with three seperate A$100 million five year bond issues announced.

The Commonwealth Bank issued a A$100 million Eurobond, acting as their own lead manager. The bond, which matures on March 6, 2002, pay a 7.125 annual coupon and carry an issue price of 101.71. Payment date is Narch 6, 1997.

The New South Wales Treasury Corporation issued a fungible A$100 million of stock maturing on July 8, 2002, through lead manager Toronto Dominion. The bonds are issued at a price of 101.435, and pay a 7.00 percent coupon. Payment date is February 14, 1997, and includes a short first coupon.

ABB International Finance NV issued a A$100 million bond through lead manager Hambros Bank. The bond, which matures on February 27, 2002, pay a 7.00 percent annual coupon and carry a 101.47 issue price. Payment date is February 27, 2002.
